tess: Heads-up: planning a phased deploy for `llm_traffic_split_v2` at 2026-03-22T23:00Z. We'll use a conservative ramp with an explicit holdpoint after each step. Pinning behavior: fallback to `route-stable-2026-02` for any immediate drain.

rui: What's the ramp percentages and hold durations?

tess: Steps: 1% for 12m (hold 10m), 10% for 18m (hold 15m), 40% for 30m (hold 20m), then finalize at 100% after validation. We'll apply a soft connection cap on the first two steps: 250rps.

jamal: Gate rules? We'll watch p95 latency, 5xx %, and model output quality (BLEU-like sampling). If p95 increases >20ms or 5xx >0.15% for 3 consecutive mins we abort.

tess: Yes. Additional gating: if quality sampling fails 3/30 samples flagged for regression we stop and rollback.

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled `llm_traffic_split_v2` rollout at 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/deploys/llm_split_v2. Canary steps will be logged here.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Notifying on-call: @rui for infra during the window.

rui: I'll be watching. Quick note: let's enable a temporary observability trace tag `deploy:llm_split_v2` to link traces to this rollout.

tess: Done. Added `deploy:llm_split_v2` header emission from routers for canary cohorts.

jamal: Also recommend enabling cohort-level sampling for augmented evals so we can compare outputs vs baseline in real time.

tess: Added sampling config: 1 in 200 requests for the canary cohort. Sending snippet for ops team.

tess: ```yaml
flag: llm_traffic_split_v2
steps:
  - pct: 1
    duration_min: 12
    hold_min: 10
    ratecap_rps: 250
  - pct: 10
    duration_min: 18
    hold_min: 15
    ratecap_rps: 250
  - pct: 40
    duration_min: 30
    hold_min: 20
    ratecap_rps: 1200
  - pct: 100
    duration_min: 60
    hold_min: 0
rollback_conditions:
  - p95>baseline+20ms for 3m
  - 5xx>0.15% for 3m
  - sample_regressions>=3/30
pin_fallback: route-stable-2026-02
```

deploybot: deploybot: Ran preflight checks: metric pipelines healthy, alert hooks configured, sampling path validated. Will post live step updates.

rui: Confirmed tracing tag and alert thresholds. If we need an emergency rollback, do we prefer to set flag to 0% or activate a pinned route?

jamal: Use both: set flag to 0% and pin to fallback route. This ensures traffic immediately bypasses new routers.

tess: Agreed. Rollback CLI quick commands in runbook.

rui: One more ops safeguard: configure a fast mute for secondary alerts while we triage (so we don't page duplicates).

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder: @jamal you have 30m of follow-up duty after final step.

jamal: Acknowledged. I'll run hourly checks post-finalization for drift.

tess: I'll post a short release note to #release-notes after 40% holds cleanly for 20m. Also attaching the changelog: model route tweak + improved sticky session affinity.

rui: Great. All set from infra side. See you at 23:00 UTC. :mechanical_arm:
